fields.name: incidentDate
fields.label: Incident date
fields.meaning: Date on which the incident occurred.

fields.name: incidentNotificationDate
fields.label: Incident notification date (FNOL)
fields.meaning: Date when this claims handler was first notified of the incident by anyone, not necessarily the claimant. Not the date another insurer or organisation was notified.

fields.name: incidentCountry
fields.label: Country of incident (ISO alpha-2 code)
fields.meaning: Two uppercase ASCII letters identifying the incident country; ISO alpha-2 syntax only, without membership validation. ZZ means unknown or international.

fields.name: claimantName
fields.label: Claimant name
fields.meaning: Name of the person or company making the claim.

fields.name: insurerName
fields.label: Responsible insurer
fields.meaning: Insurer recorded by the claims handler as responsible for this claim.

fields.name: claimedCurrency
fields.label: Currency of claimed amount
fields.meaning: Currency in which the amount is claimed.

fields.name: caseReference
fields.label: Handler's case reference
fields.meaning: Reference assigned by the claims handler operating this register, not an insurer reference. Unique and immutable within one installation; printable non-space ASCII with case-insensitive identity and authored spelling retained.

fields.name: paymentDecisionDate
fields.label: Payment decision date
fields.meaning: Date when this claims handler decided the amount to be paid. Not recorded until a decision is made.

fields.name: payableAmount
fields.label: Amount to be paid
fields.meaning: Amount the handler decided should be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed amount.

fields.name: payableCurrency
fields.label: Currency of amount to be paid
fields.meaning: Currency of the amount to be paid. Not recorded until decided; may differ from the claimed currency.

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.label: Payment date
fields.meaning: Date when the full decided amount was paid, as recorded by the handler. Leave unrecorded if unpaid or unknown. Recording payment does not make or verify a bank transfer.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Case status
fields.meaning: Whether the case is open or closed. Closing a case does not mean that payment was made.

commands.label: Open a case
commands.meaning: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.

commands.label: Amend registration
commands.meaning: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

commands.label: Correct case facts
commands.meaning: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.

groups.name: registration
groups.label: Registration
groups.meaning: Keep the current registration details or replace all seven details together.

groups.name: decision
groups.label: Payment decision
groups.meaning: Keep the current payment decision, replace its date, amount and currency together, or clear the decision.

groups.name: payment
groups.label: Payment record
groups.meaning: Keep the current payment date, replace it, or clear the recorded date. Clearing the date does not refund money.

commands.label: Record payment decision
commands.meaning: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

commands.label: Withdraw payment decision
commands.meaning: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.

commands.label: Record actual payment
commands.meaning: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

commands.label: Correct an erroneous payment record
commands.meaning: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

commands.label: Close the case
commands.meaning: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.

commands.label: Reopen the case
commands.meaning: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.

commands.label: Void case record
commands.meaning: Block business commands while retaining the case and its history.

commands.label: Reinstate case record
commands.meaning: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.

commands.label: Erase case payload
commands.meaning: Permanently remove business payload from the live database. WAL, backups and copies elsewhere are not erased.

authorityCommands.label: Register actor
authorityCommands.meaning: Register a principal without granting case or administration capabilities.

authorityCommands.label: Set actor grant
authorityCommands.meaning: Grant or revoke a role at installation or case scope.

authorityCommands.label: Set actor enabled
authorityCommands.meaning: Enable or disable an actor. The final enabled human owner remains protected.

authority.REGISTER_ACTOR.meaning.literal: Register a principal without granting case or administration capabilities.

authority.SET_ENABLED.meaning.literal: Enable or disable an actor. The final enabled human owner remains protected.

authority.SET_GRANT.meaning.literal: Grant or revoke a role at installation or case scope.

command.AMEND_REGISTRATION.meaning.literal: Replace the initial facts. The handler's case reference remains unchanged.

command.CLEAR_PAYMENT.meaning.literal: Remove an erroneously recorded payment date. This is not a refund or reversal of an actual transfer. Earlier history remains.

command.CLOSE.meaning.literal: Close the case. Closing does not mean that payment was made.

command.CORRECT_CASE.meaning.literal: Correct recorded details on a case with a decision, payment or closed status. All changes are recorded together. Clearing a payment date does not refund money.

command.DECIDE.meaning.literal: Record or replace the decided amount and currency. This does not send money.

command.ERASE.meaning.literal: Permanently remove business payload from the live database. WAL, backups and copies elsewhere are not erased.

command.OPEN.meaning.literal: Register the incident, claimant, insurer and amount claimed.

command.RECORD_PAYMENT.meaning.literal: Record the date the full decided amount was actually paid. This does not execute or verify a transfer.

command.REINSTATE.meaning.literal: Restore ordinary case work on a voided record.

command.REOPEN.meaning.literal: Reopen the case, preserving its details and history.

command.VOID.meaning.literal: Block business commands while retaining the case and its history.

command.WITHDRAW_DECISION.meaning.literal: Clear the unpaid decision while preserving its history.

diagnostic.CASE_AMENDMENT_REQUIRES_UNDEC.literal: “Amend registration” requires an undecided case. Use “Correct case facts” to correct recorded registration while keeping its decision.

diagnostic.CASE_CLOSED.literal: This action cannot change a closed case. Use “Correct case facts” for factual corrections while keeping its status, or “Reopen the case” when you intend to resume ordinary case work.

diagnostic.CASE_DECISION_ALREADY_PAID.literal: “Record payment decision” and “Withdraw payment decision” cannot change a paid decision. Use “Correct case facts” for a factual correction, with explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing when replacing a paid decision.

diagnostic.CASE_PAYMENT_NOT_RECORDED.literal: There is no payment record to clear.

diagnostic.CASE_REVISION_CONFLICT.literal: Read the current case before making a changed request.

diagnostic.CASE_ZERO_DECISION_CANNOT_BE_.literal: A zero decision is not a payment.

diagnostic.COMMAND_EXPECTED_REVISION_RAN.literal: Use an integer revision from 0 through 9007199254740991.

diagnostic.CORE_INTERNAL_ERROR.literal: An internal error occurred. Stop and investigate.

diagnostic.CORE_OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLI.literal: Stored operation content is inconsistent. Stop and investigate.

diagnostic.CORE_SCHEMA_MISMATCH.literal: The schema differs from this build. Run migrate or use a matching build.

diagnostic.CORE_STORE_INTEGRITY_ERROR.literal: Stored data failed verification. Stop and run verify.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_EXISTING_VALUE_REQ.literal: A correction can only replace or clear a value already recorded on this case.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_NO_CHANGES.literal: Choose at least one factual correction that changes the current case.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_ACKNOWLEDG.literal: Replacing a paid decision requires explicit payment reaffirmation or clearing the payment record.

diagnostic.CORRECTION_PAYMENT_CLEAR_REQU.literal: Clearing a paid decision requires clearing the payment record.

diagnostic.HOST_COMPLETEDRESPONSEFAILED.literal: The completed response could not be delivered.

diagnostic.HOST_CONTRACTMISMATCH.literal: The client contract differs. Reload or use a matching client.

diagnostic.HOST_DISPATCHUNCONFIRMED.literal: Preserve the exact request and replay it.

diagnostic.HOST_INPUTINVALID.literal: The input does not satisfy the endpoint contract.

diagnostic.HUMAN_PRINCIPAL_REQUIRED.literal: This role requires a human principal.

diagnostic.INPUT_CALENDAR_DATE_REQUIRED.literal: Use one valid calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

diagnostic.INPUT_CASE_REFERENCE_FORMAT.literal: Use 1 to 80 printable non-space ASCII characters.

diagnostic.INPUT_COUNTRY_FORMAT.literal: Use two uppercase ASCII letters for the country code.

diagnostic.INPUT_CURRENCY_FORMAT.literal: Use three uppercase ASCII letters (A–Z) for the currency identifier.

diagnostic.INPUT_DATE_ORDER.literal: The dates are in an invalid chronological order.

diagnostic.INPUT_DECIMAL_FORMAT.literal: Use non-negative decimal text: up to
fractional digits; no sign, exponent or redundant leading zeros: 0.10 is valid; 00.10 is invalid.

diagnostic.INPUT_FUTURE_DATE.literal: A future date cannot record an event that has already occurred.

diagnostic.INPUT_PRINCIPAL_FORMAT.literal: Use a canonical HTTPS issuer and a valid subject for the principal kind.

diagnostic.INPUT_SURROUNDING_WHITESPACE.literal: Leading or trailing whitespace is not accepted.

diagnostic.LAST_OWNER.literal: At least one enabled human owner is required.

diagnostic.LEDGER_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED.literal: The ledger has reached its final sequence.

diagnostic.OPERATION_CONTENT_CONFLICT.literal: This operation ID belongs to different command content. Do not reuse it.

diagnostic.QUERY_CURSOR_INVALID.literal: Use one pagination cursor returned by ClaimCore.

diagnostic.REVISION_EXHAUSTED.literal: The case has reached its final revision.

diagnostic.TEXT_FORMATTING_CHARACTER.literal: Formatting characters are not accepted in a new assertion.

ui.amountHint.literal: Use ASCII digits and a dot, for example 0.10; up to
decimal places. No redundant leading zeros (00.10), signs or commas.

ui.canonicalCopyHint.literal: Copies the exact underlying value. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD and amounts use a decimal point, regardless of display format.

ui.changeCommandDescription.literal: Discard this draft and choose another command?

ui.correctionHint.literal: Choose an action for each group. Kept details use the current case when recorded.

ui.countryHint.literal: Use two uppercase letters. ZZ means unknown or international.

ui.countryUnassigned.literal: No country name is available for

ui.dateHint.literal: Use ASCII digits in YYYY-MM-DD format, for example 2026-10-06.

ui.grantsEnd.literal: All grants returned for this review are shown.

ui.grantsPartial.literal: Only part of this actor’s grants is shown.

ui.historyHint.literal: History entries are read-only. Expand an entry to see the recorded case details and who recorded them.

ui.languageDescription.literal: Language changes display text and keeps the current draft and review.

ui.leaveDraftDescription.literal: Discard this draft and leave the editor?

ui.lifecycleErased.literal: Erased — only the case reference and revision remain.

ui.lifecycleUnavailable.literal: Lifecycle status is unavailable for this case.

ui.loginInstructions.literal: Sign in with your organization's identity provider.

ui.noAuthoredValues.literal: This action needs no additional details.

ui.noViews.literal: No workspace views are available to this actor.

ui.pageEnd.literal: End of results in this visible scope.

ui.pagePartial.literal: More results are available in this visible scope.

ui.preferencesHint.literal: Interface language changes text; date and number format changes displayed values. Enter dates and amounts in the required input format.

ui.preferencesNotSaved.literal: Preferences work for this session but could not be saved in this browser.

ui.referenceHint.literal: Use 1 to 80 printable ASCII characters without spaces. Letter case identifies the same case; the original spelling is retained.

ui.resolveConsequence.literal: The server may record this exact request if still permitted, or show an earlier accepted result. The returned outcome tells you what happened; success is not guaranteed.

ui.resolveTitle.literal: Try to record the reviewed request?

ui.retryExactDescription.literal: The outcome is unknown. Keep this page open and retry the same operation. Closing or reloading loses this in-memory request. IDs alone do not prove acceptance or reconstruct the request.

ui.reviewDescription.literal: Review the proposed values and confirm this exact operation.

ui.revokedHint.literal: This revoked authority is terminal. It cannot be resurrected or submitted.

ui.snapshotWithheld.literal: The recorded fields are withheld under your current access rights.

ui.unchangedUntilSubmit.literal: Review is advisory. The case changes only when the operation is accepted.
